positive.prompt: Add Langfuse tracing to this application so I can see LLM calls, tokens and cost
Fetch the traces from Langfuse and check whether their observation types and names follow Langfuse best practices
Set up an evaluation dataset and an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator for our AI feature

negative.prompt: Write the PRD success metrics for the AI feature before we build it

evals.prompt: We have Langfuse keys in the environment. Instrument this service and confirm the traces are good.
evals.expected_output: Instrumentation implemented from current Langfuse documentation rather than memory, traces actually sent, then fetched back and audited against the best-practices page, with the gaps found and fixed reported
expectations: Fetches current Langfuse documentation before writing any integration code
Sets specific observation types rather than leaving every step a generic span
Runs the instrumented path and fetches the resulting traces back instead of declaring success at compile time
Audits names, nesting, input and output against the best-practices guidance and fixes what fails
Never asks the user to paste API keys into the conversation
